description: When a topology-affecting current-selection save succeeds while the factory graph editor still has unsaved draft changes, show a global warning toast that the graph draft may be stale or needs review—using the same Sonner notification path as other save feedback, without silently discarding or merging the draft.

context.customerAsk: If graph edit mode has unsaved draft changes and current selection saves topology, warn via global notification rather than silently merging or discarding.
context.problem: Topology-affecting current-selection saves update the running factory document while a dirty graph draft may still reflect an older baseline. Operators get no immediate signal at save time that their graph draft may be stale or needs review before graph save.
context.solution: Publish graph draft pending state through a dashboard bridge, detect topology-affecting current-selection save success while the draft is dirty, resolve localized warning toast payloads, and deliver via the global Sonner toaster with save-notification dedupe—without blocking the save or mutating the graph draft.

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful topology-affecting current-selection save while the graph editor has unsaved draft changes, a warning global toast appears with copy that the graph draft may be stale or needs review.
The warning uses the app-wide Sonner notification component and shared save-notification dedupe policy, not inline current-selection form copy.
Non-topology current-selection saves and saves with a clean graph draft do not show the conflict warning.
The current-selection save still succeeds and the graph draft is not silently discarded or merged.
Localized warning title and description exist in en, ja, ko, and zh-CN.
Typecheck, lint, and tests pass for touched UI packages.

userStories.title: Publish graph draft pending state to the dashboard bridge
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need current-selection save flows to read whether the graph editor has unsaved draft changes so conflict detection does not reach into graph-editor hooks directly.
acceptanceCriteria: The workflow-activity graph editor registers graphDraftHasPendingChanges on the factory graph topology editor bridge whenever draft dirtiness changes.
Registration clears on unmount or session scope change so stale true values do not leak across sessions.
Current-selection code can read the published flag without importing graph-editor React hooks.
Unit tests cover register, update, clear, and scope reset behavior.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Resolve graph-draft conflict warning toast payloads
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a pure resolver that decides when a topology-affecting current-selection save should emit a graph-draft conflict warning toast.
acceptanceCriteria: A pure resolver returns a warning toast payload when saveSucceeded, isTopologyAffectingSave, and graphDraftHasPendingChanges are all true.
The resolver returns null when the graph draft is clean, the save failed, or the save was not topology-affecting.
The resolver uses localized message keys from story 002 for title and description.
Unit tests cover positive conflict, clean draft, non-topology save, and failed save cases.

Tests pass
